description: This file is a test script for Git's --orphan branch creation functionality. It sets up various scenarios and checks the behavior of the 'git checkout --orphan' command, including branch creation, rejection scenarios, reflog behaviors, and error handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the provided commands and verifying they succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure, running the provided commands and verifying they fail.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal test clock to simulate passage of time.

methods.name: test_cmp_config
methods.description: Compares Git configuration values against expected defaults.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the output of commands or files to expected values.
